text:
zara: restore failure for tenant=polaris, decrypt AccessDenied from KMS during snapshot restore.
kevin: see logs?
zara: logs:
```
2026-05-12T11:03:21Z restore: kms:Decrypt AccessDenied for arn:aws:iam::123456:role/backup-runner
```
mina: did we recently change the backup agent's execution model to a privsep container? that swapped the principal to `backup-runner` last night.
sec-oncall: tagging infra. initial hypothesis: role rename + privsep change left no bound grant on CMK. quick checks: `aws kms list-grants --key-id alias/backup-main` and CloudTrail for kms:CreateGrant entries.
deploy-bot: Noted: deployment deploy/backup-agent v3.2.0 rolled 2026-05-12T02:00Z, change: enable-privsep=true.
kevin: i ran `aws kms list-grants --key-id alias/backup-main` 1 grants but none for backup-runner. CloudTrail shows no CreateGrant after the deploy.
mina: the deploy pipeline has a post-deploy job that should rebind grants but it runs as a transient task that lacks kms:CreateGrant in its assumed-session policy. looks like a permissions regression.
zara: mitigation: create a scoped grant for the backup-runner role and re-run the restore. command used: `aws kms create-grant --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456:key/aa11bb --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456:role/backup-runner --operations Decrypt`
kevin: grant created G-pt9. restarted restore job.
sec-oncall: verify status?
deploy-bot: small restore succeeded. decrypt OK. marking incident mitigated.
mina: followups: 1) add IAM check in the deploy pipeline that ensures the post-deploy rebinder has kms:CreateGrant permission (owner: infra) 2) add a CI integration test: simulate privsep switch and assert grant presence before cutting traffic (owner: platform) 3) audit for leftover temp credentials in containers and restart any that contain stale files (owner: sec) 4) add an EventBridge rule: when deployment toggles a principal (role rename or enable-privsep) and no kms:CreateGrant occurs within 10m, alert sec channel (owner: infra).
kevin: also recommend documenting the principal lifecycle in backup runbook and including the one-liner to rebind grants. I'll add the CLI in the runbook.
sec-oncall: filing ticket SEC-2026-3344 with owners and timeline.
audit-bot: Incident SEC-2026-3344 created; postmortem required.
zara: TL;DR: switching to privsep changed runtime principal; pipeline lacked permission to rebind KMS grants -> restores blocked. immediate fix: created explicit grant; long term: pipeline/CI fixes and runbook updates.
kevin: lesson: infrastructure changes that alter runtime identity must be atomic with grant rebinding or include a privileged rebinder path.
